summary: Korsana Biosciences (formerly Cyclerion Therapeutics) consummated its reverse merger on September 8, 2026, closing the April 1, 2026 agreement, as amended April 17, 2026, with private Korsana Biosciences. Each Korsana common and Series A preferred share converted into Cyclerion common stock after a reverse stock split; Cyclerion merged via two wholly owned subsidiaries, left as surviving registrant. The combined entity renamed Korsana Biosciences, trading as KRSA on Nasdaq, with former Korsana holders expected to hold majority control. Item 5.01 confirms a change in control. Watch post-close ownership split, trading liquidity, and integration risk.
